output.population: A single human participant scanned in multiple studies over ten years on the same 7 T scanner ("human phantom")
output.summary: Ultrahigh resolution whole-brain in vivo MRI from one participant on a single 7 T scanner: angiography, T1- and T2-weighted structural scans, quantitative susceptibility mapping, diffusion tensor imaging and resting-state functional MRI, unprocessed plus processing results.
